scope: One host, synthetic exact integer log units, no timed H20 auditor or physical/GPU speedup. Complete stream primary; beta-survivor stream diagnostic. Nine blocks are repeated measures on one host, not independent systems. Preprocessing+Q totals are modeled from separately measured medians, not timed end-to-end executions. Given closed_R excludes common separately measured closure; a raw-edge direct BF alternative can avoid closure entirely. Synthetic mix weights are designed coverage, not workload prevalence.
